C1291.title: 2023 Payment License Renewal Success Rate Drops, Jinyuntong Payment Fined by PBOC
C1291.summary: In January 2023, the People Bank of China released the fifth batch of payment license renewal results: among 18 institutions, 12 renewed, 2 were suspended, and 4 did not submit renewal applications and would not renew, with a notably lower success rate. Analysis suggested that compliance, operation, or rectification issues at some institutions might affect renewal outcomes, reflecting strict regulatory requirements for penetrating supervision and compliance capability of payment institutions.
